slug: 2025-07-27 Centrafrique - le prix des cartes d'identite reduit apres cinq ans de violations de la loi

facts.fact: Corbeau News Centrafrique reports the government cut the national identity card (CNI) price to 4,500 FCFA by interministerial order of 26 June 2025, after citizens paid 6,000-6,750 FCFA for five years under a public-private arrangement with the firm Almadina, and says the card is indispensable to vote.

systems.owner: Government of the Central African Republic, with the firm Almadina as partner
